_comment: Text witnesses for OCR-repaired names (structures.py). Each entry: a name as extracted (raw) and a SPELLING of the same compound printed elsewhere in the SAME patent's text, found 2026-10-03 by reading the raw patent text on Hetzner (corpus/raw/<patent>.txt; OCR-tolerant search; the spelling is copied as printed, OCR noise and all). structures.py resolves the spelling with the same repair chain and lifts the name from PROVISIONAL to repaired+witness ONLY if it gives the same structure. This is not a hand-authorised rewrite: the name's own reading is unchanged, it is only confirmed. Ivan chose this mechanism 2026-10-03. A8 is deliberately absent: its evidence is indirect (the patent prints the substrate, not the ketone twice). It was closed by a hand-authorised REWRITE in structures.py instead.
